project: Industrial Simulator Ecosystem - Multi-Plant Digital-Twin Control Center
version: 7.0 - Physically-Modelled Simulation Ecosystem (PV + Water + Wind + Oil & Gas) with Live Industrial Protocol Services + Simulated Plant/Equipment Layer (Breakers, Transformers, VFDs, Relays, Process Skids) exposed over Modbus / IEC104 / GOOSE / MQTT / Web + Fleet Dashboard
purpose: Academic research, teaching and operator-training digital twins of several utility-scale industrial plants. Every signal is produced by a physical model (not random noise) and exposed over real, reachable wire-protocol services (Modbus TCP, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850 GOOSE, MQTT) that external SCADA/clients can connect to. A fleet manager runs all plants concurrently; a web dashboard lets operators navigate between them and run any selection (or all).

access.single_plant_hmi: http://0.0.0.0:5000/  (shows the ACTIVE simulator; select via dashboard or POST /api/fleet/select)
access.mqtt_broker: amqtt on localhost:1883 (started separately: amqtt -c /tmp/broker.yaml). Publishers connect automatically and retry; topics sim/<id>/state and sim/<id>/unit/<idx>.
access.note: Flask dev server (no auth, open CORS) - fine for a trusted lab, not for public internet.

architecture.manager: simulation/manager.py (class SimulationManager + Simulator). Builds 4 simulators, each with its own ProtocolHub (unique port set) and MqttPublisher. A single 4 Hz background loop steps every RUNNING sim on a shared clock, feeds real per-site weather + live fleet capacity factor, pushes Modbus, and publishes MQTT (~2 s).
architecture.base_class: simulation/plants/base.py (BasePlant): shared clock (live+sim), generic units list (exposed as plant['inverters'] for protocol compatibility), alarm evaluation, energy accounting, history, Modbus map builder, snapshot(); fills legacy UI env keys via _ensure_env_keys() so the original HMI works for ANY plant type.
architecture.plants: simulation/plants/{water,wind,oilgas}.py plus the original PV plant (simulation/pv_plant.py, driven by simulation/profiles.py build_plant).

ecosystem.note: Each simulator is fully independent (own physical model + own protocol sockets + own MQTT topic). Wind uses a realistic power curve (cut-in 3, rated 12, cut-out 25 m/s) with hub-height wind via power law from real 10 m wind. Water is a process load with diurnal demand and process telemetry (influent/effluent flow, turbidity, chlorine residual, tank level). Oil & gas models reservoir-pressure decline, production (oil bbl/d, gas mmscfd, water cut) and separator pressure. WIND and OIL&GAS expose INDUSTRY-REALISTIC SCADA TAG MAPS (see protocol_services.Modbus_TCP.notes): per-unit registers carry turbine wellhead-specific tags instead of generic P/Q/I/V. EVERY plant also exposes a SIMULATED BALANCE-OF-PLANT & SUBSTATION EQUIPMENT LAYER (simulation/plants/equipment.py; <plant>.equipment + snapshot key 'equipment'): PV=23 items, Water=29, Wind=81, Oil&Gas=71. Common substation equipment: Incoming MV Breaker (main, controls the grid-connection/grid-fault), Main Step-up Transformer, Protection & Control IED, Bay Controller/RTU, Revenue Energy Meter (Wind/Oil&Gas add a Collector Bus/RMU). Per-unit: PV AC feeder breaker + DC isolator + string monitor per inverter; Water feeder breaker + VFD/soft-starter per motor; Wind turbine transformer + feeder breaker + converter per WTG; Oil&Gas plant skids (Test Separator, Production Manifold, Gas Compressor, Export Pump, Flare/PSV) + per-well X-mas tree/choke, ESP VSD, wellhead isolation valve. Equipment STATUS is simulated from live plant state (closed/open/running/stopped/energized/de-energized/ok/alarm) with ANALOG TELEMETRY (current A, winding temp C, load %, position %, pressure bar), and is OPERABLE from the network: Modbus control coils at addr 100+, IEC104 C_SC_NA commands (IOA=1000+i) with activation confirmation, Web API (/api/equipment/control, /api/fleet/<id>/equipment/control), and HMI buttons in the 'Plant Equipment' panel. A control drives the physical model (trip a breaker -> that unit/inverter trips; open the main breaker -> grid fault) and propagates to GOOSE status bits, IEC104 spontaneous/interrogated values, MQTT, and the register map immediately.

plant_model.name: Helios Utility PV Plant (default PV twin)
plant_model.configuration: 6 central inverters x 250 kWac, 10 strings/inverter, 25 kWp/string (60 strings, 1.5 MWp DC / 1.5 MWac)
plant_model.note: The PV plant is SELECTABLE at runtime via the 'DIGITAL TWIN' dropdown (simulation/profiles.py) or POST /api/select_profile. Non-PV plants are fixed physical models. Switching the PV twin does NOT restart protocol services (ProtocolHub.rebind keeps sockets bound).

digital_twins.concept: Multi-target platform for cybersecurity research on PV/SCADA infrastructure, now extended to a multi-plant ecosystem (water/wind/oil&gas) for broader OT/SCADA training.
digital_twins.weather_feed: simulation/live_feed.py (WeatherFeed, Open-Meteo, no API key). Each simulator is seeded with REAL per-site weather for its own (lat, lon): ambient temperature, wind speed (m/s), cloud cover. Background thread refreshes every 600 s; falls back to synthetic environment when offline.

modes.sim: Accelerated simulation clock (default). sim_time advances at time_scale (default x120) from a 05:30 start; operators can skip to any hour and change acceleration.
modes.live: Real wall-clock mode (1x): each plant computes its real current generation for its own latitude/longitude/date. Toggled globally via POST /api/control {action:'set_mode', params:{mode:'live'|'sim'}}.

physical_model.solar_geometry: Declination from day-of-year; solar elevation & azimuth from latitude and solar hour (PV).
physical_model.irradiance: Clear-sky GHI/DNI via air-mass attenuation; POA from fixed-tilt beam + isotropic diffuse + ground reflected; stochastic cloud attenuation. Anchored to measured shortwave_radiation from WeatherFeed when available.
physical_model.wind_power_curve: WindPlant: cut-in 3 m/s, rated 12 m/s, cut-out 25 m/s; power = rated*( (v-cut_in)/(rated-cut_in) )^3 capped; hub-height wind via power law (alpha~0.14) from 10 m real wind.
physical_model.water_load: WaterPlant: diurnal demand curve (peaks ~07:30 and ~19:00) drives pump/blower/filter/UV/sludge motor loads; process telemetry computed from demand.
physical_model.oilgas: OilGasPlant: reservoir-pressure decline model; production scales with well availability and pressure; water cut + separator pressure tracked.
physical_model.grid: Frequency with droop-like deviation vs power imbalance; MV voltage slow variation; power factor.

faults_and_disturbances.grid_fault: Trips all units, forces 0 MW (PV), frequency/voltage excursion, critical alarms + GOOSE trip count.
faults_and_disturbances.unit_trip: Manual trip/restore of a single unit (also driven by Modbus coil writes) for ANY plant type.
faults_and_disturbances.cloud_pass: Transient cloud attenuation (PV) for a configurable duration.
faults_and_disturbances.curtailment: Active-power curtailment setpoint (0-100%) from the grid/PLC.

time_acceleration: Simulated clock advances in real time x1..x600 (default x120). 'Skip to hour' jumps the clock; energy integrated each tick. LIVE mode tracks real wall clock (1x).

backend.simulation_engine: simulation/manager.py (SimulationManager): 4 simulators, shared 4 Hz stepping thread; per-sim ProtocolHub + MqttPublisher.

protocol_services.note: Each simulator owns its OWN port set (see ecosystem.simulators.ports). PV=5020/2404/5880, Water=5021/2405/5881, Wind=5022/2406/5882, Oil&Gas=5023/2407/5883. The protocol layer only needs plant.modbus_map(), plant.plant['inverters'], plant.grid, plant.env, plant.running and the control methods, so BasePlant makes ANY plant type work unchanged.

Modbus_TCP.notes: Holding registers 40xxx (plant summary) + 401xx (per-unit) + 410xx (equipment: 4 regs/block = status code + up to 3 analog telemetry). Coil map generalised to N units: coil i trip/restore unit i, coil n = grid fault, n+1 = plant run, n+2 = curtailment, n+3 = fault present; EQUIPMENT CONTROL coils at addr 100+ (one per controllable item: breakers, VFDs, converters, wellhead valves, main MV breaker). Store dynamically sized from unit+equipment count, refreshed each tick via push(). Per-UNIT TAGS ARE INDUSTRY-REALISTIC: WIND WTG-nn -> Active Power, Reactive Power, Rotor Speed, Local Wind, Pitch Angle, Nacelle Temp, Phase Voltage, Phase Current, Power Curve % (690 V LV). OIL&GAS WELL-nn -> Lift Power (kW), Oil Rate (bbl/d), Gas Rate (mmscfd), Water Cut (%), Flowing Tubing Pressure/FTP (bar), Wellhead Temp (C), Phase Voltage, Phase Current (400 V LV). Wind plant summary drops generic 'Cloud Cover' in favour of Wind Speed Hub / Avg Rotor Speed / Turbines Online-Total / Max Nacelle Temp.

IEC_60870_5_104.verified: STARTDT handshake, C_IC_NA interrogation (full image as I-frames), spontaneous M_SP_NA / M_ME_NC I-frames. ASDUs chunked (<=30 elements / <255-byte APDU) for large plants.
IEC_60870_5_104.equipment: Interrogation + spontaneous both carry EQUIPMENT ASDUs: single-point M_SP_NA at IOA 1000+i and measured M_ME_NC at IOA 2000+i (primary analog per item). Two-way: C_SC_NA (type 58) with IOA=1000+i acts on the i-th equipment item and returns an activation-confirmation ASDU (COT=7); verified to trip a wellhead via its breaker.

IEC_61850_GOOSE.gateway: GOOSE is Layer-2 multicast; a TCP gateway re-publishes the REAL BER-encoded GOOSE APDU (tag 0x61) to any subscriber, length-prefixed (4-byte big-endian). gocbRef per plant kind (e.g. WIND_GCB_001). Raw-frame emission requires root (scapy); the message log + stNum/sqNum + TCP gateway work as non-root.
IEC_61850_GOOSE.equipment_bits: The AllData dataset now starts with one boolean per EQUIPMENT item (in the same order as <plant>.equipment: 23 PV / 29 Water / 81 Wind / 71 Oil&Gas), followed by the unit-running bits, grid-connected, and plant-run bits. Equipment STATE CHANGES increment stNum so protection/SCADA subscribers see switch-trip events on the wire.

MQTT.broker: localhost:1883 (amqtt). Optional/best-effort: publishers retry until reachable.
MQTT.topics: sim/<id>/state (full snapshot, retained) and sim/<id>/unit/<idx> (per-unit, retained), for id in {pv,water,wind,oilgas}.
MQTT.client: simulation/mqtt_pub.py (MqttPublisher): paho-mqtt v2 (or v1) with version-tolerant callbacks, MQTT v3.1.1, dedicated reconnect thread (blocking connect + loop_start, retries forever).

frontend.tech: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no external CDN dependencies (works fully offline)
pages: templates/base.html (single-plant HMI, targets ACTIVE sim; PLANT-SPECIFIC via hmi.js)
style: static/css/main.css (control-room dark theme + per-kind process-visual styles)
logic: static/js/hmi.js (PLANT-SPECIFIC rendering engine: per-kind KPI strip, multi-series trend chart (canvas), animated process visuals (SVG), unit cards, supervisory controls)
static/js/main.js (orchestrator: 1s state poll, 2s history, 4s modbus, 3s protocol; detects active plant kind and drives HMI)
dashboard_features: Fleet grid of cards: per-sim kind badge, running/stopped pill, live KPIs (active power, capacity, units online, alarms).
Protocol/MQTT status LEDs (Modbus/IEC104/GOOSE/MQTT listening) + port badges.
Per-card START/STOP toggle and OPEN (selects sim as active and loads the single-plant HMI).
Toolbar RUN ALL / STOP ALL / REFRESH.
Links to the single-plant HMI (top bar 'OPEN HMI') and back (HMI top bar 'FLEET').
frontend.plant_specific_hmi: The single-plant HMI auto-detects the active simulator's kind and renders a DIFFERENT dashboard per plant (KPI strip, trend chart, animated process visual, unit cards and supervisory controls all come from per-kind tables in static/js/hmi.js). Selecting a different sim in the fleet (or switching PV twin) rebuilds the HMI to that plant's layout. No JS errors; charts auto-fit to the recorded sim-time window. (1) PV -> solar KPIs (power/energy/efficiency/POA/cell temp/grid/CO2) + multi-series trend (AC power + POA irradiance + cell temp) + animated single-line diagram (array, inverters, 33kV MV bus, transformer, grid) + per-inverter cards. (2) WATER -> works KPIs (demand power/treated flow/turbidity/chlorine/tank level/grid/assets online) + trend (treated flow + demand power + Cl2 + tank level) + animated treatment process train (Raw->Sediment->Aeration->Filtration->UV, dashed flow animation, live tank-level fill) + per-motor cards. (3) WIND -> farm KPIs (farm power/hub wind/avg rpm/max nacelle/turbines online/grid/daily energy) + trend (farm power + hub wind + avg rpm) + animated turbiner row (9 spinning rotors scaled by per-turbine rpm, wind streaks, stars, hub wind/rotor/farm readouts) + per-WTG cards (power curve, rpm, local wind, pitch, nacelle). (4) OIL&GAS -> production KPIs (lift power/oil bbl-d/gas mmscfd/water cut/reservoir bar/grid/wells online) + trend (oil + gas + water cut + reservoir) + animated production & separation flow (6 wellheads with live choke status, compressor flywheel, 3-phase separator oil/water split, flickering flare sized by gas rate) + per-well cards (oil/gas/water-cut/FTP/lift/heading).
visualizations: Plant-specific KPI strip (7 cards) + multi-series canvas trend chart (per-kind series, self-scaled y-axes, auto-fit x-axis to sim window) + animated SVG process visual (per kind) + plant-specific unit cards.

Supervisory control panel (per-kind: common run/pause, time accel, skip-hour, curtailment, grid-fault, unit trip, export + PV-only weather scenarios), substation protocol status, live alarm log, SCADA Modbus register/coil table.

Plant Equipment panel (per-sim substation + process equipment table: status LEDs, live analog telemetry, CLOSE/START / OPEN/STOP control buttons) + the SCADA Register Map shows an 'Equipment Holding Registers (41xxx)' section.

validation.ecosystem_verified: All 4 simulators start concurrently; Modbus binds 5020-5023, IEC104 2404-2407, GOOSE 5880-5883; HTTP on 5000; MQTT (amqtt) connected=True for all 4 with live retained state+unit topics on sim/#.
validation.fleet_api_verified: /api/fleet lists 4 sims; /api/fleet/<id>/state and /api/fleet/<id>/modbus return correct per-sim data; start/stop/select/runall/stopall work; selecting a sim changes /api/state to that kind.
validation.realistic_tag_maps_added: Wind (WTG-nn) and Oil&Gas (WELL-nn) Modbus per-unit registers now carry industry-specific SCADA tag names (turbine nacelle/rotor/pitch/power-curve; wellhead lift power/oil-gas-water rates/FTP/water cut). Verified live via /api/fleet/<id>/modbus (oilgas HR=174 incl 8 per-well tags; wind HR=240 incl 9 per-turbine tags).
validation.equipment_layer_verified: Simulated BALANCE-OF-PLANT & SUBSTATION equipment (PV 23 / Water 29 / Wind 81 / Oil&Gas 71 items: MV breaker, transformer, protection IED, bay RTU, meter, collector bus, per-unit breakers/VFDs/converters/transformers, oil&gas separators/compressor/pump/PSV + per-well choke & VSD & isolation valve) modelled with live status + analog telemetry. Verified network-accessible & two-way: (1) Modbus HOLDING READ of 41xxx equip regs OK and COIL WRITE (addr 107 = WTG-01-CB / 111 = WELL-01-XMT) trips the unit (fault=MANUAL_TRIP) then restores; (2) IEC104 STARTDT + interrogation returns 202 equip ASDUs (M_SP_NA IOA 1000+, M_ME_NC IOA 2000+) and a C_SC_NA command (type 58, IOA 1000+11) operated WELL-01-XMT off with activation-confirmation; (3) GOOSE dataset bits now = equip bits(<=71) + unit bits + grid + plant and a state change bumps stNum; (4) MQTT sim/oilgas/state topic carries equipment[71]; (5) Web /api/equipment + /api/fleet/<id>/equipment + control endpoints + HMI 'Plant Equipment' panel with CLOSE/START-OPEN/STOP buttons all work.
validation.port_bug_fixed: ProtocolHub constructor takes (plant, modbus_port, iec104_port, goose_iface, goose_gateway_port); manager now passes the GOOSE gateway port as a keyword (goose_gateway_port=...) so non-PV hubs no longer collided on 5880.
validation.mqtt_fixed: paho-mqtt v2 changed on_connect signature (5 args) and removed asyncio.coroutine (hbmqtt broken on Py3.12); publisher now uses version-tolerant callbacks, MQTT v3.1.1, and a reconnect thread.
known_issues_fixed: GOOSE gateway port collision: non-PV simulators bound 5880 (PV's port) instead of 5881-5883 because the manager passed the port as the wrong positional argument.
Stop did not update plant.running: manager.stop_sim/start_sim now also call plant.set_running() so the HMI shows the correct state.
MQTT disconnected under paho v2: fixed callback signature + switched to a robust connect/loop_start reconnect loop; installed amqtt broker (hbmqtt incompatible with Python 3.12).

notes: For production, replace the Flask dev server with Gunicorn/uWSGI behind Nginx, add authentication and time-series storage. For real GOOSE on the wire, run as root so scapy can open raw sockets. The MQTT broker (amqtt) must be started separately (amqtt -c /tmp/broker.yaml) for live message streaming; without it, publishers degrade gracefully.
